entities.name: EFAIL
entities.gloss: A vulnerability in email encryption standards allowing exfiltration of plaintext from encrypted emails via HTML styling.

entities.name: PGP
entities.gloss: A data encryption and decryption standard used for securing email communications.

entities.name: S/MIME
entities.gloss: A standard for public key encryption and signing of MIME data in email communications.

entities.name: Apple Mail
entities.gloss: An email client developed by Apple Inc. for macOS.

entities.name: iOS Mail
entities.gloss: An email client developed by Apple Inc. for iOS devices.

entities.name: Mozilla Thunderbird
entities.gloss: A free and open-source cross-platform email client developed by the Mozilla Foundation.

entities.name: OpenPGP
entities.gloss: An open-source standard for encrypting and signing data, derived from PGP.

entities.name: CVE-2017-17688
entities.gloss: A vulnerability identifier for OpenPGP CFB gadget attacks associated with the EFAIL flaw.

entities.name: CVE-2017-17689
entities.gloss: A vulnerability identifier for S/MIME CBC gadget attacks associated with the EFAIL flaw.

relations.head: EFAIL
relations.evidence: Критична вразливість EFAIL в PGP та S/MIME
